versions.subject: feat: new linux rules #4095)
versions.detection:
selection_1:
    type: PATH
    name:
        - /etc/lsb-release
        - /etc/redhat-release
        - /etc/issue
selection_2:
    type: EXECVE
    a0:
        - uname
        - uptime
        - lsmod
        - hostname
        - env
selection_3:
    type: EXECVE
    a0: grep
    a1|contains:
        - vbox
        - vm
        - xen
        - virtio
        - hv
selection_4:
    type: EXECVE
    a0: kmod
    a1: list
condition: 1 of selection_*
versions.spl: (type="PATH" name IN ("/etc/lsb-release", "/etc/redhat-release", "/etc/issue")) OR (type="EXECVE" a0 IN ("uname", "uptime", "lsmod", "hostname", "env")) OR (type="EXECVE" a0="grep" a1 IN ("*vbox*", "*vm*", "*xen*", "*virtio*", "*hv*")) OR (type="EXECVE" a0="kmod" a1="list")
